messages:
maria: Heads-up  spotted p95 jump (~110ms) for /generate-route after the priority-aging deploy (~18:12 UTC). p50 looks fine. Canary panel flagged it.

alex: Seen it. Live traces point at increased queue_wait for lower-priority traffic. My working theory: preemption windows create smaller batches for low-pri, increasing per-request overhead.

jin: Quick probe query I ran:
```
SELECT priority_level, phase, percentile(latency_ms,50) p50, percentile(latency_ms,95) p95, count(*) samples
FROM telemetry.traces
WHERE endpoint='/generate-route' AND ts >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY priority_level, phase
```
High-pri queue p95 ~82ms (samples 121k), low-pri queue p95 ~370-400ms (samples ~4k). Compute phase p95s are similar across priorities (~60-85ms).

sam: p99 didn't move much overall, so this is likely a cohort mid-tail shift rather than extreme tail noise. Also double-check if any retry/fallback rule triggered that window.

lia: We have a routing fallback to variant-b when queue_depth > 1.1k; variant-b adds ~90ms for some payload shapes. Audit logs show more variant-b routes in that timeframe.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: saved snapshot -> https://redwood.internal/telemetry/snapshots/6023456700 (includes rollup CSV + trace ids)

alex: Two practical platform changes: 1) split latency by phase (queue_wait vs service_time) in the console so percentiles don't mask phase regressions; 2) expose sample_count with each percentile and surface a low-sample confidence badge. Right now the single merged latency obscures root cause.

maria: Agreed. UX should show p50/p95/p99 per phase and annotate deploys/config changes (PR #3456) so triage can correlate metrics -> changes quickly.

jin: I'll prototype rollup queries with `phase` and `priority_level` dimensions. Example:
```
SELECT phase, priority_level, percentile(latency_ms,95) p95, count(*) samples
FROM telemetry.rollups
WHERE endpoint='/generate-route' AND window='1m'
GROUP BY phase, priority_level
```
Prelim: p95(queue|low)=330ms, p95(compute|low)=62ms -> queue dominates.

sam: Also verify sampling policy for canaries. If the sampler overweights debug/slow clients, p95 will be biased. Add a sampling-sanity check in rollup ingestion (flag if samples < 500 for a percentile bucket).

lia: :thumbsup: Can we add an endpoint-breakdown hover that shows p50/p95/p99 split by phase as tiny stacked bars? That'd speed triage.

maria: I'll file a short UX ticket: (A) phase-split latency pane, (B) sample_count + confidence badge in legend/tooltips, (C) auto-annotations for routing/config deploys with PR link. Who wants query/rollup work?

alex: I'll take the dashboard wiring and add the deploy annotation metadata.

jin: I'll add `priority_level` and `phase` to rollup ingestion, plus the low-sample alert and an export of trace_ids for slow cohorts.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: created INF-11011 "Latency pane: phase breakdown, sample_count, deploy annotations" and attached a mockup image.

sam: Small UX nudge: make combined "total latency" an opt-in aggregate view; default to phase-separated percentiles for endpoints that experience queueing. Prevents repeated confusion when queue mix changes shift p95.

maria: Good call. After the PRs land we'll re-run canary gating and check p95 again. If queue_wait remains elevated for low-pri we can tune aging thresholds or raise fallback hysteresis. Thanks all.
